After the rites, family tensions start to rise and Seong-jin drops the bombshell that he won’t be taking on the family business.

While there, Lady Vernon is determined to be a matchmaker for her daughter Frederica - and herself too, naturally. Stars Kate Beckinsale and Chloe Sevigny.

Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Yolngu Boy

Botj, Lorrpu and Milika are three Yolngu teenagers who once shared a dream of becoming great hunters. Now aged 14, only Lorrpu hasn't diverged. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

Botj, Lorrpu and Milika are three Yolngu teenagers who once shared a dream of becoming great hunters. Now aged 14, only Lorrpu hasn't diverged. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Yolngu Boy

Botj, Lorrpu and Milika are three Yolngu teenagers who once shared a dream of becoming great hunters. Now aged 14, only Lorrpu hasn't diverged. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

He samples their unique diet and discovers that the Okinawan custom of forming lifelong social groups called 'Moai' could be one reason for their low levels of heart disease.

programme.title: Trade Secret: The Polar Bear Market
programme.desc: Trade Secret follows three unlikely allies on a mission to protect polar bears from international commercial trade. Filmed over six years across nine countries, the film exposes the sanctioned sale of hundreds of polar bears each year on the global market. But as the investigation deepens, it uncovers a disturbing truth: those entrusted with safeguarding the species may be entangled in their continued commercialisation.

programme.title: House Of The Seasons
programme.desc: It's summer, and the whole Kim family have gathered in Daegu for the ancestral rites. This includes Seong-jin, the eldest grandson of the family, whose father has taken on the family business: a tofu factory. After the rites, family tensions start to rise and Seong-jin drops the bombshell that he won’t be taking on the family business.

programme.title: Love And Friendship
programme.desc: Set in 18th century English society, the film focuses on the machinations of a beautiful widow, Lady Susan Vernon, who, while waiting for social chatter about a personal indiscretion to pass, takes up temporary residence at her in-laws' estate. While there, Lady Vernon is determined to be a matchmaker for her daughter Frederica - and herself too, naturally. Stars Kate Beckinsale and Chloe Sevigny.

programme.title: Under The Cover Of Cloud
programme.desc: A recently-fired journalist returns to his hometown in Tasmania and sets out to write a piece of non-fiction about the game of cricket and legendary Australian batsman and exalted Tasmanian, David Boon. Directed by and starring Ted Wilson. Also stars Colleen Wilson and David Boon.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Yolngu Boy
programme.desc: About the coming-of-age of three Aboriginal boys in Arnhem Land who inhabit two cultures at once - that of North-East Arnhem Land and also western culture. Botj, Lorrpu and Milika are three Yolngu teenagers who once shared a dream of becoming great hunters. Now aged 14, only Lorrpu hasn't diverged. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

programme.title: Gremlins

Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

Keanu Reeves and Alex Winter star in the most outrageous comedy in the history of history. With appearances by Napoleon, Beethoven, Socrates, Billy the Kid and Abraham Lincoln. Directed by Stephen Herek and also stars George Carlin. (From the US) (Comedy) (1989) (Rpt) PG

programme.title: House Of The Seasons
programme.desc: It's summer, and the whole Kim family have gathered in Daegu for the ancestral rites. This includes Seong-jin, the eldest grandson of the family, whose father has taken on the family business: a tofu factory. After the rites, family tensions start to rise and Seong-jin drops the bombshell that he won’t be taking on the family business.

programme.title: Love And Friendship
programme.desc: Set in 18th century English society, the film focuses on the machinations of a beautiful widow, Lady Susan Vernon, who, while waiting for social chatter about a personal indiscretion to pass, takes up temporary residence at her in-laws' estate. While there, Lady Vernon is determined to be a matchmaker for her daughter Frederica - and herself too, naturally. Stars Kate Beckinsale and Chloe Sevigny.

programme.title: Under The Cover Of Cloud
programme.desc: A recently-fired journalist returns to his hometown in Tasmania and sets out to write a piece of non-fiction about the game of cricket and legendary Australian batsman and exalted Tasmanian, David Boon. Directed by and starring Ted Wilson. Also stars Colleen Wilson and David Boon.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Yolngu Boy
programme.desc: About the coming-of-age of three Aboriginal boys in Arnhem Land who inhabit two cultures at once - that of North-East Arnhem Land and also western culture. Botj, Lorrpu and Milika are three Yolngu teenagers who once shared a dream of becoming great hunters. Now aged 14, only Lorrpu hasn't diverged. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Miniature green monsters tear through the small town of Kingston Falls. Hijinks ensue as a mild-mannered bank teller accidentally releases these hideous creatures.

programme.title: Local Hero

programme.title: Golden Years

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Bill And Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Two slacker airheads, who are about to fail their history class, are given the chance to take an epic trip through time in order to help them ace their final exam. Keanu Reeves and Alex Winter star in the most outrageous comedy in the history of history. With appearances by Napoleon, Beethoven, Socrates, Billy the Kid and Abraham Lincoln. Directed by Stephen Herek and also stars George Carlin. (From the US) (Comedy) (1989) (Rpt) PG

Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. In this episode about the body, he looks for the latest methods to preserve our heart health, bones and muscles. Michael travels to Okinawa in Japan - an island famous for its long living people. He samples their unique diet and discovers that the Okinawan custom of forming lifelong social groups called 'Moai' could be one reason for their low levels of heart disease.

programme.desc: Trade Secret follows three unlikely allies on a mission to protect polar bears from international commercial trade. Filmed over six years across nine countries, the film exposes the sanctioned sale of hundreds of polar bears each year on the global market. But as the investigation deepens, it uncovers a disturbing truth: those entrusted with safeguarding the species may be entangled in their continued commercialisation.

programme.title: House Of The Seasons
programme.desc: It's summer, and the whole Kim family have gathered in Daegu for the ancestral rites. This includes Seong-jin, the eldest grandson of the family, whose father has taken on the family business: a tofu factory. After the rites, family tensions start to rise and Seong-jin drops the bombshell that he won’t be taking on the family business.

programme.title: Love And Friendship
programme.desc: Set in 18th century English society, the film focuses on the machinations of a beautiful widow, Lady Susan Vernon, who, while waiting for social chatter about a personal indiscretion to pass, takes up temporary residence at her in-laws' estate. While there, Lady Vernon is determined to be a matchmaker for her daughter Frederica - and herself too, naturally. Stars Kate Beckinsale and Chloe Sevigny.

programme.title: Under The Cover Of Cloud
programme.desc: A recently-fired journalist returns to his hometown in Tasmania and sets out to write a piece of non-fiction about the game of cricket and legendary Australian batsman and exalted Tasmanian, David Boon. Directed by and starring Ted Wilson. Also stars Colleen Wilson and David Boon.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Yolngu Boy
programme.desc: About the coming-of-age of three Aboriginal boys in Arnhem Land who inhabit two cultures at once - that of North-East Arnhem Land and also western culture. Botj, Lorrpu and Milika are three Yolngu teenagers who once shared a dream of becoming great hunters. Now aged 14, only Lorrpu hasn't diverged. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Miniature green monsters tear through the small town of Kingston Falls. Hijinks ensue as a mild-mannered bank teller accidentally releases these hideous creatures.

programme.title: Local Hero
programme.desc: A Texas oil executive is sent to buy a Scottish village for a refinery but finds himself enchanted by the locals and landscape, forcing him to question his values and dreams.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: Retired couple Martha (Virginia McKenna) and Arthur (Bernard Hill) turn to heists to reclaim lost pensions in this feel-good caper with Alun Armstrong, Una Stubbs, and Simon Callow.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Bill And Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Two slacker airheads, who are about to fail their history class, are given the chance to take an epic trip through time in order to help them ace their final exam. Keanu Reeves and Alex Winter star in the most outrageous comedy in the history of history. With appearances by Napoleon, Beethoven, Socrates, Billy the Kid and Abraham Lincoln. Directed by Stephen Herek and also stars George Carlin. (From the US) (Comedy) (1989) (Rpt) PG

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: My Greek Table With Diane Kochilas
programme.sub-title: Flavors Of The Athenian Art Scene
programme.desc: Diane prepares a meal for some of her closest friends. On the menu: Char-Broiled Cabbage 'Steaks' with Pomegranate Seeds and Lemon Zest; Whole Baked Fish with Leeks; and a Greek Yogurt Panna Cotta.

programme.title: Freshly Picked
programme.desc: Freshly Picked is back for another season with Simon serving up brand-new tasty recipes.

programme.title: Food Safari Earth
programme.desc: Maeve explores the marvellous abundance of summer vegetables and fruits in dishes from around the world. Tomato Day is the most special day in the Italian food calendar, and Maeve joins three generations of the Baggio Family in suburban Melbourne as they preserve the goodness of summer with a home-made passata. Later, Maeve explores the versatility of eggplant with iconic chef Tetsuya Wakuda.

programme.title: Andy's East Coast Kitchen Crawl

programme.title: No Taste Like Home
programme.desc: Through Oxford and the Yorkshire coast to London, Antoni helps Florence unearth family stories that reveal the origins of their love for food.

programme.title: Ainsley's Football Feast

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK
programme.desc: It's the last night in Bradford and sales director Tom's turn to host. He's drawing on his French heritage for his menu in the hope of wowing his guests with simple dishes, executed well.

Here he discovers the world’s most expensive cheese made from moose milk, before heading into the mountains to visit the Myhrbodarna Dairy and chef Magnus Nilsson at Fäviken.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers Comfort Food
programme.desc: Si and Dave tackle dishes that you never dreamed you could make yourself. But they prove that homemade can beat shop-bought when they prepare gravalax, jam doughnuts, their own corned beef and even an Indian favourite, paneer.

programme.sub-title: Britain's Most Expensive Houses Series 2 Ep 5
programme.desc: In Mayfair, sales broker Diana is vying for the listing on a 30 million pound mega home for the agency, but convincing property developer Kam she's the right broker for the job is no easy task. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

Filmed over six years across nine countries, the film exposes the sanctioned sale of hundreds of polar bears each year on the global market. But as the investigation deepens, it uncovers a disturbing truth: those entrusted with safeguarding the species may be entangled in their continued commercialisation.

After the rites, family tensions start to rise and Seong-jin drops the bombshell that he won’t be taking on the family business.

While there, Lady Vernon is determined to be a matchmaker for her daughter Frederica - and herself too, naturally. Stars Kate Beckinsale and Chloe Sevigny.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Yolngu Boy
programme.desc: About the coming-of-age of three Aboriginal boys in Arnhem Land who inhabit two cultures at once - that of North-East Arnhem Land and also western culture. Botj, Lorrpu and Milika are three Yolngu teenagers who once shared a dream of becoming great hunters. Now aged 14, only Lorrpu hasn't diverged. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.desc: About the coming-of-age of three Aboriginal boys in Arnhem Land who inhabit two cultures at once - that of North-East Arnhem Land and also western culture. Botj, Lorrpu and Milika are three Yolngu teenagers who once shared a dream of becoming great hunters. Now aged 14, only Lorrpu hasn't diverged. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

Filmed over six years across nine countries, the film exposes the sanctioned sale of hundreds of polar bears each year on the global market. But as the investigation deepens, it uncovers a disturbing truth: those entrusted with safeguarding the species may be entangled in their continued commercialisation.

This includes Seong-jin, the eldest grandson of the family, whose father has taken on the family business: a tofu factory. After the rites, family tensions start to rise and Seong-jin drops the bombshell that he won’t be taking on the family business.

programme.title: Love And Friendship
programme.desc: Set in 18th century English society, the film focuses on the machinations of a beautiful widow, Lady Susan Vernon, who, while waiting for social chatter about a personal indiscretion to pass, takes up temporary residence at her in-laws' estate. While there, Lady Vernon is determined to be a matchmaker for her daughter Frederica - and herself too, naturally. Stars Kate Beckinsale and Chloe Sevigny.

programme.title: Under The Cover Of Cloud
programme.desc: A recently-fired journalist returns to his hometown in Tasmania and sets out to write a piece of non-fiction about the game of cricket and legendary Australian batsman and exalted Tasmanian, David Boon. Directed by and starring Ted Wilson. Also stars Colleen Wilson and David Boon.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Yolngu Boy
programme.desc: About the coming-of-age of three Aboriginal boys in Arnhem Land who inhabit two cultures at once - that of North-East Arnhem Land and also western culture. Botj, Lorrpu and Milika are three Yolngu teenagers who once shared a dream of becoming great hunters. Now aged 14, only Lorrpu hasn't diverged. Botj is a lost soul in trouble with the law, and Milika is more interested in football and girls. One of the central themes of the film is the divide between the prosperity-driven, materialistic western ideal of life and the everyday reality faced by young Aborigines. Directed by Stephen Johnson, and stars Sean Mununggurr and John Sebastian Pilakui.

programme.title: Gremlins

It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

Directed by Stephen Herek and also stars George Carlin. (From the US) (Comedy) (1989) (Rpt) PG
